# Identity debt of the data reached through the local GOT -- GENERATED by `make got-debt`
#   (python3 tools/gotident.py --write-debt, after a full `make check`).
# One row = one green copy (SYMBOL@UNIT) with identical instructions that, through the
# local GOT, reaches an object in another section (e.g. a .bss buffer where the original
# has a .rodata literal, an empty .bss table where the original has initialized .data,
# a data object where the original has a function pointer) or with another name (when
# the object of the original has one in config/symbol_addrs.txt). Same ratchet as the
# GOT debt. See tools/gotident.py.
